test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is 'nutrition'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Based on the content of the given passage, the most appropriate title could be "Poor Hygiene at Local Food Outlets and its Effects on Health".
 
• The passage describes the poor hygienic conditions prevalent in many local dhabas and fast food joints, and how this can lead to health problems due to the use of low-quality packaging material, improper storage conditions, and inadequate cleaning of food.
 
• The passage also mentions the high content of trans fats in the food, which can lead to negative effects on health. 
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank **number 4** would be "**nutrition**" because the passage is discussing the low quality of food cooked at these establishments, and mentions that it is rich in oil content but low in nutrition.
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **condition** - the state of something with regard to its physical or other qualities
 
• **proportion** - a part, share, or number considered in comparative relation to a whole
 
• **production** - the action of making or manufacturing from components or raw materials
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

Correct Passage:__ *At most of the local dhabas and fast food joints, poor hygienic conditions prevail. The contamination occurs due to poor quality packaging material or unhygienic storage conditions. Food cooked may not be washed or cleaned properly. It is low in **nutrition**, rich in oil content especially trans fats which make one (5) ______, lousy and dull.*
